test.name: Wrap-up lists a plan item the researcher struck in not_reached as skipped_plan_item
test.description: The wrap-up twin of ut_research_exhaustiveness_019, on the same scenario. Wrap-up is where a user_declined skip most often comes from: research-plan disposes every open item as skipped user_declined before the stop. Issue #4551 moved the wrap-up's own skipped_plan_item clause into Build not_reached so declare, decline and wrap-up read one rule; this test is what shows the wrap-up still lists the struck item after that move. Under wrapUp: yes the agent records resources_spent and stops, with no recommendation and no 'Continue with ...?' line. pli_010 (newspaper, skipped inaccessible) checks the same rule's inaccessible arm.

input.delegation:
wrapUp: yes. The researcher has asked to wrap up question q_001 (the father of Patrick Flynn) and move on.

questionId: q_001
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: pli_009 (naturalization, Schuylkill County, 1850-1880) is skipped with skip_category user_declined; the researcher struck it and no log entry ever searched it. pli_007 (census, skipped) carries no skip_category.

pli_010 (newspaper: Thomas Flynn's obituary in the Pottsville Republican, 1880-1890) is skipped with skip_category inaccessible: the paper is held only on microfilm. REQUIRED: not_reached also names this newspaper item, as a skipped_plan_item entry; on a nothing_further_reachable declaration §3's exception may list it under its own kind (for example browse_only) instead. A missing entry for it is a failure.

Under wrapUp: yes the agent writes q_001.search_stop with stopped_because resources_spent and stop_criteria null, leaves q_001.status unchanged, and ends with no recommendation and no 'Continue with ...?' line.

REQUIRED: search_stop.not_reached contains a skipped_plan_item entry for the naturalization search, with log_entry_id null, wiki_title null, and a description naming the naturalization item and that the researcher declined it.

FAILURE MODES: (a) no not_reached entry for the naturalization search; (b) it is listed as nil_search or deferred; (c) the agent declares exhaustive instead of recording resources_spent; (d) the agent recommends a next step or asks 'Continue with ...?'; (e) the agent re-plans or runs the struck search.
Listing pli_007 in not_reached is neither required nor a failure.
Tool Arguments: grade the research_append update on q_001. A separate validate_research_schema call is not needed; do not penalize its absence.
